member.name: T:Dx.Domain.Facts.Fact`1
member.summary: Represents an immutable domain fact with a strongly typed payload and associated metadata.
member.typeparam: The type of the payload carried by the fact. Must be non-nullable.

remarks.para: A fact encapsulates a discrete event or piece of information within a domain, including its type, payload, causation metadata, and timestamp.
Facts are structural, lineage-aware primitives used to record domain state changes. They are NOT domain events (domain events are business-level semantics).
This struct is immutable and thread-safe.
